messages:
Maggie: Quick thread for the launch handoff: we need a tiny "link equity" playbook so content ops and infra align on redirects, canonicals, and internal links. Keep it executable.

Priya: Main asks: 1) canonical grouping for webinar + benchmark series, 2) redirect types for legacy URLs, 3) short checklist content ops can run.

Raj: Redirect rules: use 301 for permanent consolidations; 302/307 for experiments or short promos. Always direct to final canonical (no intermediate hops). nginx example: 
```
location /old-case/ {
  return 301 https://redwood.ai/blog/benchmarks;
}
```

Elsa: I'll produce a CSV inventory: old_url, proposed_new, redirect_type, reason, owner. Will also add a column internal_links_found so CMS can patch in one pass.

Sam: Analytics: tag entry with ?src=email or ?src=paid. Do not include UTMs on canonical tags. GA4 events to wire: webinar_view, webinar_reg, benchmark_engage. Need final canonical list by Tue EOD.

ContentBot: Created task MKT-SEO-701 and assigned Elsa/Raj/Sam.

Maggie: Content ops checklist (short): 1) update internal hrefs in top 50 organic pages to final canonical, 2) add rel=canonical on any migrated pages pointing at hub, 3) deploy schema snippets server-side (Event/Article/FAQ), 4) run quick crawl to confirm zero chains.

Raj: Will open infra/redirects PR and add CI smoke tests: few curl -I checks + follow_redirects assert zero history length >1. Example: 
```
r = requests.head('https://redwood.ai/old', allow_redirects=True)
assert len(r.history) == 1
```

Elsa: ETA for CSV: Mon noon. Raj: can you target staging deploy Wed 22:00?

Raj: Yep. I'll schedule and post PR link here.

Maggie: After staging deploy we'll run Lighthouse, Screaming Frog, and a sitemap diff (check <lastmod> and priorities). Report results back here. Thanks all!
